mainEntity.name: How long does it take to implement AI citable content strategies?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for implementing AI citable content strategies varies depending on the volume and complexity of your existing content and the resources available. A comprehensive audit and initial optimization phase for a medium-sized website could take several weeks to a few months. However, citability is an ongoing effort, requiring continuous monitoring, refinement, and adaptation as AI technologies and algorithms evolve. Quick wins can be achieved by prioritizing core, high-value content for immediate optimization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Implementation time varies by content volume, from weeks to months for initial optimization. It's an ongoing process requiring continuous monitoring and refinement, with quick wins possible by prioritizing high-value content.
